title: Watry Industries Sets the Standard for Aluminum Castings Nationwide | Users | observernewsonline.com
text:
08/20/2025, Sheboygan, WI // PRODIGY: Feature Story //
Watry Industries has long established itself as the leading force in aluminum castings, serving a wide range of industries across North America with precision engineering and unmatched expertise. With roots dating back to 1959, the company’s consistent pursuit of quality, efficiency, and design collaboration has positioned it as a trusted partner in engineered casting solutions for customers requiring stringent specifications and durability.
As a fully integrated aluminum foundry , Watry delivers complex net shape castings through a process that emphasizes low-porosity and pressure-tight integrity. The Sheboygan-based company offers permanent mold casting services, including automated pouring, CNC machining, leak testing, heat treatment, and powder coating. This vertically integrated model minimizes lead times, streamlines production, and enhances quality control, making it a preferred supplier across various sectors, including medical, instrumentation, electronics, industrial equipment, just to list a few of the many industries they serve.
Watry Industries The company distinguishes itself not just through its technology but also through its engineering partnership model. Customers often approach Watry early in their design process, relying on the company’s engineering team to optimize part design for manufacturability and cost. By engaging in collaborative design and using cutting-edge simulation software, Watry helps clients reduce weight, improve strength, and ensure castability, an approach that saves time and reduces expenses across the supply chain.
With over six decades of casting experience, Watry continues to expand its reputation for high-quality aluminum castings by investing in state-of-the-art equipment and process automation. The company’s in-house capabilities include automated machining centers, coordinate measuring machines (CMMs), real-time X-ray inspection, tensile testing, and spectrographic analysis, which are instrumental in meeting the most demanding performance criteria. The result is castings that meet or exceed industry standards, whether for medical housing, gear components, or power tools.
As a premier aluminum foundry , Watry serves clients not only in Wisconsin but also throughout the United States. The company's Midwest location in Sheboygan, WI, provides logistical advantages for national distribution while maintaining the personalized service they are known for.
The company’s approach to continuous improvement and employee training fosters a culture of innovation and accountability. Their ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system underpins every stage of the casting process, from initial material specification to final inspection. Whether producing high-volume runs or preliminary prototypes, Watry offers repeatable quality and reliable delivery performance.
Watry's website provides detailed information on their aluminum castings capabilities, technical resources, and customer case studies that demonstrate how their process contributes to cost-effective product lifecycle management. The site showcases success stories across applications ranging from robotics to high-performance industrial electronics.
Watry’s difference lies in its deep technical knowledge, fully integrated aluminum casting facility, and proactive design collaboration with clients. These strengths allow the company to transform complex casting challenges into manufacturable, high-quality parts that meet rigorous standards.
For more information about Watry Industries, visit the website at https://watry.com/ .
About Watry Industries
Watry Industries specializes in precision aluminum permanent mold castings with full-service machining and finishing. The company serves clients across North America from its fully integrated aluminum foundry in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.
